facts.pricing_text: Simple, transparent pricing Cline is free for individual developers. Pay only for AI inference on a usage basis - no subscriptions, no vendor lock-in. Open Source Free For individual developers n/a ... Is Cline free? Yes! The Cline open source extension is completely free for individual developers. You only pay for AI inference on a usage basis - no subscriptions, no vendor lock-in. You can bring your own API keys or use the Cline provider. What do I pay for? You only pay for AI inference credits when you use AI models. This is usage-based pricing - you pay for what you use, nothing more. There are no subscriptions or seat fees for the open source version.
